So working carefully must be your number one priority!  Who you are  - You are hands-on and can physically handle this work - You have Experience on EPT, or you willing to learn - You work accurately - You have a sense of responsibility - You have a good command of the Dutch and/or English language, both verbally and in writing  Where will you work Welcome to Imperial! A company that is part of Imperial Logistics, a South African listed company, with 50,000 employees worldwide. With 150 employees and 5 branches in Benelux, Imperial Chemical Logistics B.V. specializes in the storage and distribution of packaged chemical products.
